name: Waikiki Aquarium High School Teen Educator Program
org: Waikiki Aquarium (University of Hawaii at Manoa)
what_you_do: Teens learn about Hawaiian sea life and practice talking with visitors about it. They build leadership and public speaking skills.
who_can_apply: High school students. The aquarium says regular volunteers must be 18, with exceptions for teen programs.
duration: One 4-hour shift a week for 5 weeks
deadline_text: The page said Summer 2026 applications were open, with no closing date listed. Summer 2027 not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply link on the aquarium volunteer page when it is time. If you have a question, send an email to volunteer@waikikiaquarium.org.
notes: The page does not state the exact age range or application dates. The aquarium is open during repairs. Other aquarium volunteer roles are for 18 and older.
